subject: general
question: If 15th Feb 2010 is Monday. then what will be the day of the week on 7th July 2011?
solution:
Given : 15th Feb 2010 was Monday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 15th Feb 2010 to 7th July 2011 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2010
 15 Feb 2010 - 31 December 2010
 365 days - 31 January - 15 February = 319 days
 319 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2011
 1st January 2011 - 7th July 2011
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 7 July = 188 days
 188 ÷ 7 = 6
 
 

 Total odd days
 (10 ÷ 7) = 3
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 15th Feb 2010 to 7th July 2011 ⇒ 3

⇒So, Three odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

∴ Thursday was the day of the week on the 7th July 2011.

Hence, "**Thursday**" is the correct answer.
